build_mask_rcnn_c4_model: build a Mask R-CNN C4 model config using GeneralizedRCNN with ResNet-50 backbone and FrozenBN normalization
create_rpn_config: create an RPN proposal generator config with 15 anchors and configurable NMS thresholds
configure_res5_roi_heads: configure Res5 ROI heads with 80 classes, ROIAlignV2 pooling, and a mask head
define_anchor_generator: define a DefaultAnchorGenerator with 5 anchor sizes and 3 aspect ratios at stride 16
setup_box_predictor: setup FastRCNNOutputLayers box predictor with Box2BoxTransform weights and configurable test score threshold
